subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: What should be the canonical product contract for this combined fallback-ordering and configured-model-input guardrail follow-up?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider fallback policy and config validation strictness, and the source shows current behavior intentionally preserves broad custom model metadata.

options.title: Split policy and guardrail ownership
options.body: Keep the model-input contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 and create or reopen a focused fallback benchmark/policy tracker for the cost-first ordering work.

options.title: Keep this issue as the broad tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical combined policy item and let narrower related issues stay linked as evidence or implementation slices.

options.title: Defer strict validation
options.body: Document the current explicit-metadata behavior and prioritize diagnostics until maintainers choose an authoritative capability source.

recommendation.title: Split policy and guardrail ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the model-input contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 and create or reopen a focused fallback benchmark/policy tracker for the cost-first ordering work.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-main signal across the schema, fallback runtime, docs, and product-policy surfaces involved in the decision.
